units.statement: theorem L3_DIV {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (zbar : Fˣ) (hzbar : Polynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype (zbar : F) ψ = 0) (B B'' : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hB'' : B'' ≠ 0) (hBd : B.natDegree < σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) (hB''d : B''.natDegree < σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) (Rdev Q : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hdiv : B * B'' = Q * Φhat + Rdev) (hRd : Rdev.natDegree < σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) : Rdev ≠ 0 ∧ σ.w Rdev = σ.w B + σ.w B'' ∧ σ.digPrime zbar Rdev = σ.digPrime zbar B * σ.digPrime zbar B''

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSi {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (e' h' : ℕ) (w' : Polynomial ℤ_[p] → ℤ) (hw' : IsSlotMinWeight w' Φhat e' h' σ.w) (hiaug : IAug σ Φhat e' h') (f gg : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : gg ≠ 0) (hfg : f * gg ≠ 0) : w' f + w' gg ≤ w' (f * gg)

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSii {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (e' h' : ℕ) (w' : Polynomial ℤ_[p] → ℤ) (hw' : IsSlotMinWeight w' Φhat e' h' σ.w) (B : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hBc : inC Φhat B) : w' B = (e' : ℤ) * σ.w B

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSiii {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (hmon : Φhat.Monic) (e' h' : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.gcd e' h' = 1) (w' : Polynomial ℤ_[p] → ℤ) (hw' : IsSlotMinWeight w' Φhat e' h' σ.w) (hiaug : IAug σ Φhat e' h') (f gg : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : gg ≠ 0) (hfg : f * gg ≠ 0) : w' (f * gg) = w' f + w' gg

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSvi {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (hΦ' : σ'.Φ = Φhat) : σ'.R σ'.Φ = LaurentPolynomial.T σ'.s

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSviii_a {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hΦdeg : Φhat.natDegree = σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) (W' : ℤ) : (∃ B, B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ.w B = W') ↔ (∃ (γ : ℤ) (j : ℕ), (∃ C, C ≠ 0 ∧ inC σ.Φ C ∧ σ.w C = γ) ∧ j < σ.e * g ∧ W' = γ + (j : ℤ) * σ.h)

Forward+backward via L5.realRecursion (𝒲_Ĉ = ⋃_j (𝒲 + jh)). Each realized by the single-slot t_{γ,j} = (S6a realizer of γ, c ∈ O = F_Qˣ)·Φ^j (constant orbit, DEF-6). TRANSstage installs this as σ'.weightSet (after the e'-stretch bookkeeping).

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSviii_b {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (zbar : Fˣ) (hzbar : Polynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype (zbar : F) ψ = 0) (ν : ℤ) (hthr : σ.wPrev σ.Φ < ν) (a : F) (ha : a ∈ σ.nextField zbar) : ∃ B, B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ.digPrime zbar B = a

Write a = P(z̄), P ∈ K[z], deg P < g; anchor at the forced slot class j₀ (anchorCong); B := ∑_{P_k≠0} t_k·Φ^{j₀+ek} with t_k an (S6b) realizer of P_k ∈ Kˣ at parent weight > wPrev Φ (two-line mutual recursion, bottoming at base unit lifts). units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSstage {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (zbar : Fˣ) (hzbar : Polynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype (zbar : F) ψ = 0) (e' h' : ℕ) (he' : 1 ≤ e') (hh' : 1 ≤ h') (hcop' : Nat.gcd e' h' = 1) (hiaug : IAug σ Φhat e' h') : ∃ σ' : Stage p F, σ'.Φ = Φhat ∧ σ'.e = e' ∧ σ'.h = h' ∧ σ'.K = σ.nextField zbar ∧ σ'.FQ = σ.FQ ∧ σ.K ≤ σ'.K ∧ IsSlotMinWeight σ'.w Φhat e' h' σ.w

units.sketch: THE INDUCTIVE STEP. AUDIT REPAIR (round-1 TRANSstage produced 'another Stage p F without residue growth; for g>1 it omits F→F'' — DEF/TRANSstage). Now the child carries σ'.K = σ.nextField zbar = K⟮z̄⟯ (a GENUINE degree-g extension, σ.K ≤ σ'.K) and σ'.FQ = σ.FQ (base FIXED across the tower, DEF-6). units.statement: theorem L5_landBox {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (μ : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) (hord : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < μ) (hjnz : B j ≠ 0) : σ.w f < σ.w (B j) + (j : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g)

units.statement: theorem L5_landVertex {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (μ : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) (hord : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) : σ.w (B μ) + (μ : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g) = σ.w f ∧ B μ ≠ 0

units.sketch: From the distinct-ψ-order sum, ord_ψ R(f) = μ (on the anchored Ranch) ⟺ slot μ least minimizing AND its residual ψ-free. So w(B μ)+μ·ehg = w(f), B μ ≠ 0.

units.statement: theorem L5_landVertexDigit {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (zbar : Fˣ) (hzbar : Polynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype (zbar : F) ψ = 0) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (μ : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) (hord : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) : ∃ q : LaurentPolynomial ↥σ.K, σ.R f = (Polynomial.toLaurent ψ) ^ μ * q ∧ ¬ (Polynomial.toLaurent ψ ∣ q) ∧ σ.digPrime zbar (B μ) = ((zbar ^ ((μ : ℤ) * σ.t * (σ.h : ℤ) * (g : ℤ)) : Fˣ) : F) * LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype zbar q
units.moves_ref: D.8 (VERTEX) explicit digit with the normalization unit z̄^{−μm̂} [pass-10 finding 2]; MOVES ~2323-2338, 2639-2645
units.sketch: R(f) = ψ^μ·q, ψ∤q. The order-μ part of the K1 sum is z^{μm̂}·R(B_μ)·ψ^μ, so digPrime(B_μ) = z̄^{μm̂}·q(z̄), m̂ = −thg ⟹ z̄^{−μm̂} = z̄^{μthg} (the EXPLICIT unit — pass-10 finding 2, must NOT be dropped). eval₂ via GRc.

units.statement: theorem L5_landTransport {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (f f' : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) (B B' : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hd : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) (hd' : IsDevelopment Φhat f' B' N) (hslot : ∀ j, j < N → σ.R (B j) = σ.R (B' j)) : σ.R f = σ.R f'
units.moves_ref: D.8 (TRANSPORT): the triangular bijection is deterministic (slot residuals determine R(f)); MOVES ~2326-2358
units.sketch: R(f) = ∑_j R(B_j)·R(Φ̂)^j (K1 + multiplicativity along development), a deterministic function of the slot residuals. Equal slot residuals ⟹ R(f) = R(f'). FLAGGED-OK: this is DETERMINACY only (not term-by-term ψ-digit equality — FALSE per pass-9 finding 10; blueprint gap G6). The full carry Equiv is not stated; the ledger consumes only determinacy + P6ii.

units.statement: theorem L5_landTwoSided {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (μ : ℕ) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ ↔ ((∀ j, j < μ → B j ≠ 0 → σ.w f < σ.w (B j) + (j : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g)) ∧ B μ ≠ 0 ∧ σ.w (B μ) + (μ : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g) = σ.w f)
units.moves_ref: D.8 two-sided: stratum (ord_ψ = μ on the anchored polynomial) ⟺ landing cylinder (BOX + VERTEX); MOVES ~2359-2371
units.sketch: (→) landBox + landVertex. (←): given box/vertex, run the K1 sum forward — least minimizing slot is μ, R(B_μ) ψ-free (psiNotDvd), so ord_ψ Ranch = μ. Both loci defined by slot/side conditions; other coordinates carried bijectively (FactB). Digit-cylinder form: backward containment consumes no window surjectivity. Uses OrdPsiPoly over Polynomial (round-2 fix; round-1 OrdPsiEq X was vacuous).

units.statement: theorem L5_realRecursion {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hΦdeg : Φhat.natDegree = σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) (W : ℤ) : (∃ B : Polynomial ℤ_[p], B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ.w B = W) ↔ (∃ (j : ℕ), j < σ.e * g ∧ (W - (j : ℤ) * σ.h) ∈ (fun ν => (σ.e : ℤ) * ν) '' σ.weightSet)
units.moves_ref: D.9(a) Lemma REAL recursion: 𝒲_Ĉ = ⋃_{0≤j<eg}(𝒲 + j·h); MOVES ~2385-2387
units.sketch: A Ĉ-coefficient B = ∑_{j<eg} B_j Φ^j; w(B) = min_j (w(B_j)+j·h) (hK1). Achievable W ⟺ ∃ j<eg, W − jh ∈ (current-scale image of) weightSet. weightSet is PARENT-scale (round-2); the e·(−) image converts to current scale w(B_j) = e·wPrev(B_j). Single-slot realizers (hS6a) + minima achievable.

units.statement: theorem L5_realCofin {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (g : ℕ) (hg : 1 ≤ g) (fr : ℤ) (hWS : ∀ ν : ℤ, fr ≤ ν → ν ∈ σ.weightSet) (W : ℤ) (hWge : fr ≤ W) : W ∈ σ.weightSet

units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-1 realCofin assumed e ∣ W then j=0 trivialized it). Now over PARENT-scale weights: the union ⋃_j (𝒲+jh), with j over ≥ e consecutive integers, fills ALL residue classes mod e (gcd(e,h)=1) — the parent-scale weight set is genuinely cofinite (every value ≥ f_r), not only multiples of e. hWS provides the cofinite tail.

units.statement: theorem L5_realDomination {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (fr : ℤ) (hbase : σ.wPrev σ.Φ ≤ fr) (hnext : ∀ ν : ℤ, fr ≤ ν → ν ∈ σ.weightSet) : (σ.h : ℤ) > (σ.e : ℤ) * fr

units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-1 made fr a GLOBAL lower bound for every coefficient weight, trivializing it via w(1)=0 ⟹ fr≤0). Now fr is the cofiniteness ONSET (the D.9 f_r). Induction on the tower level: base h₁ ≥ 1 > 0 = e₁f₁; step: next bound e·fr+(e−1)h < e·h ≤ e·h·g = w(Φ_{r+1}); by (I-aug) L2.iaugStep every child read has slope > w(Φ_{r+1}), so h_{r+1} > e_{r+1}·(next bound). Domination closes.

units.statement: theorem L5_realConclusion {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (he1 : σ.e = 1) (lam : ℤ) (hlam : σ.wPrev σ.Φ < lam) (cc : (↥σ.K)ˣ) : ∃ B : Polynomial ℤ_[p], B ≠ 0 ∧ inC σ.Φ B ∧ σ.wPrev B = lam ∧ σ.R B = LaurentPolynomial.C (cc : ↥σ.K) * LaurentPolynomial.T (0 : ℤ)
units.moves_ref: D.9(d) any e_read=1 side value λ″ > wPrev(key) is realizable with any digit c̃ ∈ F'ˣ, position 0; MOVES ~2398-2406
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-1 assumed threshold clearance + weight membership at every W≥fr directly, and position T 0 without e=1⟹t=0). Now: e=1 ⟹ t=0 (he1t) ⟹ position −t·lam = 0 (DEF-5). Threshold is wPrev Φ (DEF-8): lam > wPrev Φ, so hS6b (full Kˣ scalars above the key parent weight, UNCONDITIONAL — no fr/weightSet junk) realizes any cc ∈ Kˣ at parent weight lam, position 0. Supplies the recentering lift t (consumed by D.10).

units.statement: theorem L5_recSpecies {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (e' h' : ℕ) (he' : 1 ≤ e') (hh' : 1 ≤ h') (hcop : Nat.gcd e' h' = 1) (w' : Polynomial ℤ_[p] → ℤ) (hw' : IsSlotMinWeight w' Φhat e' h' σ.w) : (∃ tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p], inC Φhat tt ∧ tt ≠ 0 ∧ w' tt = w' Φhat) ↔ e' = 1

(→) w'(t) = slot-1 value w'(Φ̂) = h'; w'(t) ∈ e'·(value group) for a coefficient t; so e' | h'; gcd(e',h')=1 (+ he'/hh' positivity) ⟹ e' = 1. (⟸) e'=1 ⟹ value groups coincide and such t exists by L5.realConclusion + (S6b).

units.statement: theorem L5_recVV {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecentering σ σ' cc tt) : (∀ f, σ'.w f = σ.w f) ∧ K1At σ'.w σ'.Φ (σ'.w σ'.Φ)

units.sketch: First conjunct directly from IsRecentering (the σ'.w = σ.w clause, now a field-by-field construction — DEF-10 repair). Second is σ'.hK1 (the recentered stage's own K1, = the g=1 case ψ' = z − c̃ monic irreducible degree 1 ≠ z since c̃ ≠ 0).

units.statement: theorem L5_recLiftIndep {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ1 σ2 : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (t1 t2 : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec1 : IsRecentering σ σ1 cc t1) (hrec2 : IsRecentering σ σ2 cc t2) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (zbar : Fˣ) : σ1.digPrime zbar f = σ2.digPrime zbar f

Now IsRecentering is a field-by-field construction fixing the coefficient-digit map (σ1.digPrime = σ.digPrime = σ2.digPrime on coefficients, SAME center cc). f's digit is determined by its development's coefficient digits, so σ1.digPrime f = σ2.digPrime f. units.statement: theorem L5_recSubst {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecentering σ σ' cc tt) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (zbar zbar' : Fˣ) (hshift : (zbar : F) = (zbar' : F) + ((cc : ↥σ.K) : F)) : σ'.digPrime zbar' f = σ.digPrime zbar f

units.sketch: In gr_v(A): [Φ̂] = [Φ'] + [t], so z' := R_v(Φ') = z − c̃. The residual map does not change (same T, same v); only the display variable does (z = z' + c̃). Evaluated: digPrime'(f) at z̄' = digPrime(f) at z̄ = z̄' + c̃ (hshift). The anchored transform a' = μ, R'_anch(z') = (z'+c̃)^a·h(z'+c̃) is the polynomial shadow (Case-J (z+c̃)^a). This evaluation-level rendering is the faithful change-of-transcendental in the fixed-per-stage-L₀ model (blueprint D4).

units.statement: theorem L5_recRSland {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecentering σ σ' cc tt) (μ : ℕ) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) (a' : ℤ) (Ranch' : Polynomial ↥σ'.K) (hanch' : HasAnchorK (σ'.R f) a' Ranch') : OrdPsiPoly (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C cc) Ranch μ ↔ (a' = (μ : ℤ))

Correct statement: parent ord at ψ' = X − C c̃ (degree-1, over σ.K) equals the PRIMED z'-anchor exponent a' (the a' = μ statement of D.10: R'(f) = (z'+c̃)^a·z'^μ·h(z'+c̃), so ord_{z'} R'(f) = μ). Both sides via the substitution z = z' + c̃ (recSubst) + D.8 at g=1 (landTwoSided). The z'-order is read off the anchor (HasAnchorK), never `ord_X` in Laurent.

units.statement: theorem L5_recTRANSRS {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (he1 : σ.e = 1) (cc : ↥σ.K) (hcc : cc ≠ 0) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (htc : inC σ.Φ tt) (httne : tt ≠ 0) (htw : σ.w tt = σ.w σ.Φ) (htdig : σ.R tt = LaurentPolynomial.C cc * LaurentPolynomial.T (0 : ℤ)) : ∃ σ' : Stage p F, IsRecentering σ σ' cc tt ∧ σ'.Φ = σ.Φ - tt
units.moves_ref: D.10 TRANS-RS: the recentered stage is a FULL stage (S1-S6), CONSTRUCTED; MOVES ~2478-2487
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-1 IsRecentering was an assumed unrelated stage — DEF-10). Now CONSTRUCT σ': key Φ' = Φ − t, SAME K/FQ (no residue growth at a recentering), same w' = w (v = v', recVV), same wPrev, same reps, T coefficient-pure (e=1), R' the same map re-pinned at z' = z − c̃. Discharge all S1-S6; S5 coefficient digits literally unchanged (recSubst), same 𝒜/weightSet/realizers; hRΦ: R'(Φ') = z' = T s' (s'=1). Package the field-by-field IsRecentering.

units.statement: theorem L6_moveReduceCommute {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (Φhat f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N M : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) : IsDevelopment (Φhat.map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) (f.map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) (fun j => (B j).map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) N
units.moves_ref: §0 Fact A: development commutes with reduction mod p^M; MOVES ~35-46, D.11
units.sketch: Apply Polynomial.map (PadicInt.toZModPow M) to each IsDevelopment clause. Degree bound via natDegree_map_le / Φ monic ⟹ deg preserved; vanishing maps to 0; sum via map_sum/map_mul/map_pow. (DevBijection.fourMap_devMap in general degree.)

units.statement: theorem L6_moveAffineBij {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (Φ : Polynomial R) (hmon : Φ.Monic) (hd : 1 ≤ Φ.natDegree) (f g : Polynomial R) (Bf Bg : ℕ → Polynomial R) (Nf Ng : ℕ) (hf : IsDevelopment Φ f Bf Nf) (hg : IsDevelopment Φ g Bg Ng) (heq : ∀ j, Bf j = Bg j) : f = g
units.moves_ref: §0 Fact A/B: the move (development) is an affine unitriangular BIJECTION; MOVES ~29-46
units.sketch: Injectivity of the development map (over any CommRing, so it applies to the mod-p^N boxes): equal development coefficients ⟹ f = ∑ Bf_j Φ^j = ∑ Bg_j Φ^j = g. With FactA (surjectivity) + moveReduceCommute this is the bijection of every (ZMod p^N)-box. NOTE audit: round-1 stated only injectivity; the full affine unitriangular bijection's existence/triangularity is FactA + moveReduceCommute (blueprint gap G8 records the residual scope).

units.statement: theorem L6_ledgerCount {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (n N k : ℕ) (stratum : (Fin n → ZMod (p ^ N)) → Prop) (e : {x // stratum x} ≃ (Fin (n * N - k) → ZMod p)) : Nat.card {x // stratum x} = p ^ (n * N - k)
units.moves_ref: D.11 the per-move measure ledger: #stratum = p^{nN}·vol; MOVES ~2489-2519
units.sketch: A stratum cut by k unitriangular digit equations is equinumerous to the free digits (n·N − k of them, each in ZMod p): Nat.card_congr e then Nat.card_fun = p^{n·N−k}. FLAGGED-OK: the single uniform p^{−k} model (blueprint gap G9: the per-equation alphabet-factor bookkeeping is collapsed to the exponent k).

units.statement: theorem L6_measureExact {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (n k : ℕ) (stratum : (N : ℕ) → (Fin n → ZMod (p ^ N)) → Prop) (hcard : ∀ N, Nat.card {x // stratum N x} = p ^ (n * N - k)) (N M : ℕ) (hN : k ≤ n * N) (hM : k ≤ n * M) : (Nat.card {x // stratum N x} : ℚ) / (p ^ (n * N)) = (Nat.card {x // stratum M x} : ℚ) / (p ^ (n * M))
units.moves_ref: D.11 the move is MEASURE-EXACT: the stratum mass is level-independent; MOVES ~2504-2517
units.sketch: By hcard (ledgerCount at each level) the mass at level N is p^{nN−k}/p^{nN} = p^{−k}, independent of N. Compute both ratios via hcard + pow_sub (hN, hM for ℕ-subtraction). This is DevBijection.caseE_mass in abstract form.
